morning4_start.name: {name}
morning4_start.text: *Day four. Weekend. — No school today. It's a date.*

morning4_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_seo.text: *...Had a strange dream. Seoyeon's smiling face — still lingering before my eyes.*

morning4_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_yuna.text: *...Had a strange dream. Tried to reach Yuna — my fingertips still feel empty.*

morning4_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_dain.text: *...Had a strange dream. Thought I'd caught Dain — but there's still nothing in my hands.*

morning4_nightmare_after.name: {name}
morning4_nightmare_after.text: *When I opened my eyes, there was only one name that came to mind first.*

minsu_cheer_1.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_1.text: *I check my phone. Morning message. — Minsu's at the top.*

morning4_start_2.name: {name}
morning4_start_2.text: *I take a deep breath and check the message again.*

morning4_seo_msg_1.name: Seoyeon
morning4_seo_msg_1.text: Don't be late. Fountain at the park, 10.

morning4_yuna_msg_1.name: Yuna
morning4_yuna_msg_1.text: 10 a.m. Cafe by the station. If you're late, I'm gone.

morning4_dain_msg_1.name: Dain
morning4_dain_msg_1.text: It's today. 6 p.m. in front of the gym. Ah, why am I so nervous. Should I even send this?

morning4_end.name: {name}
morning4_end.text: *One more glance in the mirror. — Good enough. Let's go.*

morning4_hidden_check.name: {name}
morning4_hidden_check.text: *Weekend. I end up passing by the school.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1.text: *The school gate is slightly open. A presence inside. The homeroom teacher comes out to the front gate. Holding a paper bag.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3.text: You? At school on a weekend?

hidden_homeroom_d4_4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_4.text: *Looking from outside the school gate, the homeroom teacher looks closer to the notepad than to the teacher's table.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_4_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_4_d.text: Students don't usually peek through the school gate when they're just passing by.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_c.text: Then let's eat first. *muttering softly* As a teacher, I should check whether a student has eaten. — Juice for you, though.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_d.text: *Even after finishing, the teacher keeps folding the corner of the cup holder.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.text: *The corner of the paper envelope is pressed under the cup holder.*
choices: Sure. Is there a cafe nearby?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.text: Having tea with a student outside school is, honestly, a little awkward.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.text: ...little. After you saw it yesterday — your hand moved again.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.text: In the end, you need someone to read it for it to feel real. Without a reader, I keep stalling.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.text: *The teacher sets down her coffee cup. Her body leans slightly toward the window.*
choices: Being your first reader... that's a lot of pressure

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.text: ...You'll know when you read it. Here's a hint — she's a bit like me.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.text: *chuckles* If it feels heavy, you don't have to read it. — But read it with a light heart. I'd prefer that.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.text: *Setting down her coffee cup* ...Meeting outside like this once in a while isn't so bad.

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.text: ...Right. I shouldn't. Go on, it's the weekend, don't hang around school. — Go have fun.

hidden_nurse_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_1.text: *School messenger notification: ‘Looking for someone to help’. My feet point toward the health room. Documents and examination tools are piled on the desk. The health teacher is calmly organizing things.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2.text: Huh? You actually came? Didn't expect that. — A student volunteering at the nurse's office on a weekend.

hidden_nurse_d4_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4.text: ...At the hospital I used to do all this alone. Night shifts — sometimes one nurse doing the work of three.

hidden_nurse_d4_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_5.text: *Looking out the window* That's why I came here. A place where they call me 'teacher,' not 'school nurse.' — It's a small difference, but it meant a lot.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.text: *The nurse's fingertip stays over the name field for a long time.*
choices: So that's why you came to this school

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.text: *She closes her mouth for a moment.* ...Juwon. Lee Juwon.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.text: ...Yeah. Here, everyone just comes with minor injuries. I like that.

hidden_nurse_d4_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6.text: Thanks. I finished much faster because of you. ...It's nothing special.

hidden_nurse_d4_choice.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_choice.text: So, what should I get you as thanks? Let's just say a teacher buying a student a meal is an extension of education.
choices: Is it okay if it's an educational activity?
That's okay, I should get going

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.text: *We headed to the snack shop in front of school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.text: Ah, it's spicy. I can't eat this as much as I used to.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.text: ...That kind of thing. Sounds strange coming from a student.

hidden_nurse_d4_pass.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_pass.text: Alright. Get home safe. And come by again sometime.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.text: *Weekend morning. I opened the nurse's office door. She's sitting in her chair in a white coat, but there's no joke memo on the desk.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.text: *The health teacher says, ‘Oh, I’m here,’ and picks up the stethoscope, then puts it back down on the desk.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.text: Is this the last counseling session?

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.text: Counseling... *she spins in her chair* Yeah. The last session.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.text: *The school nurse pretends to organize paperwork on her desk — but she's turning the same piece of paper over for the third time.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.text: *The school nurse touches her glasses. The eyes visible through them are bigger than I expected. Eyes that were hidden behind the playfulness.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.text: *It's not a question. The nurse presses her thumb against the rim of the paper cup. A dent forms.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.text: *The nurse adjusts her glasses. Her fingertip stops for a moment beneath the lens.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.text: *Talking with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.context: Day 4. The moment of farewell when asking if she'll come back after graduation. The scene where both show their true hearts. Tone: Deeper, more emotional conversation. Truth behind the playfulness. The meaning of being called by name.
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is careful and honest. She wants to call out your name but is in a cautious position. Tears come at your promise.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.text: *We headed back to the nurse's office.*

minsu_cheer_4_c.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_c.text: *I check my phone calendar. Seoyeon in the morning, Yuna in the afternoon, Dain in the evening. I didn't sleep last night trying to fit all three into one day. If even one schedule overlaps, it's over.*

minsu_cheer_4_e.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_e.text: *I take a deep breath and check the date messages again.*

minsu_cheer_1_d.name: Minsu
minsu_cheer_1_d.text: *Dain posted in the group chat lol Got plans tomorrow!! she said*

morning4_fallback_msg.name: {name}
morning4_fallback_msg.text: *Weekend morning. A few notifications waiting. — I thought it would be an ordinary day. I put down the phone and stretch. Either way, today's starting too.*

morning4_seo_msg_1_b.name: {name}
morning4_seo_msg_1_b.text: *Imperative. Even dates sound like orders. — And somehow it's funny.*

morning4_seo_msg_1_c.name: {name}
morning4_seo_msg_1_c.text: *I'm standing at the meeting spot. Will she come? After how angry she was on Friday.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1_b.text: *My feet stop at the front gate. A beat late, the teacher hides the paper envelope behind her back.*

morning4_yuna_msg_1_b.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_1_b.text: *Short. Very Yuna. No period after 'I'll leave if you're late.'*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_b.text: *Flustered* Oh, it's just — I had some paperwork left.

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_c.text: *One corner of the teacher's paper envelope is folded.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_e.text: *Hands in pockets* ...A teacher's still a teacher on weekends. You know how it is.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_c.text: *Taking a sip of coffee* Honestly? A little.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_d.text: *The teacher says it like a joke and touches the coffee cup. Two circular water rings overlap on the coaster.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_e.text: Did you write more of the manuscript yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_f.text: *She sets down her coffee cup. Pauses, as if thinking.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_b.text: Did me seeing it actually help?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_c.text: Rather than help... *looking out the window* after it was found out, the envelope felt a little lighter. Even paper gets heavy when you carry it alone.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_d.text: *The corner of a manuscript envelope shows from the teacher's bag. The folded part is a little dark with finger marks.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_e.text: Do you know what the hardest part of writing a novel is?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_b.text: *The homeroom teacher looks at {name}. Her eyes are no longer dry and detached.* *The cafe door closes slowly behind them.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_b.text: *The manuscript paper in the empty classroom yesterday comes to mind. Today I am outside school, and the corners of the cup holder keep folding.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_b.text: *The teacher smiles for a moment. The hand folding the cup holder stops.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_c.text: ...Thanks. But this, don't tell anyone — you know? ...This is our secret. The cup sleeve corner keeps folding.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_d.text: You are going to call it work again, right?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_e.text: *Freezes* ...Don't steal my line before I say it.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_f.text: *I chuckled. She chuckled too. At the same time.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_h.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_h.text: *She takes her hand out of her pocket. Her fingertips hover in the air for a moment. A habitual gesture.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_b.text: *She turns away. Her shoulders sink slightly. Her reflection appears small in the cafe glass door.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_b.text: So the patient is helping the nurse.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_c.text: *Laughing* A patient helping the nurse. I'll have to record this one.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_d.text: *Seen outside school, her smile is different. No name tag, no pens in the gown pocket. The two of us fold checkup forms and wipe down the blood pressure monitor.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_e.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_e.text: *Handing over documents* Can you sort these? By grade.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_f.text: *Sit side by side and organize documents. Every time their hands brush, the health teacher's fingertips turn to the edge of the paper.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_g.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_g.text: ...At the university hospital, I used to do all this by myself.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_c.text: *The she pauses. Sets down the papers.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_d.text: ...The hardest part back then wasn't the workload.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_f.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_f.text: No one called my name. ‘Nurse’, ‘Night Duty’, ‘Ward 3’. — It's all a title, not a name.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_g.text: *The hand on the document no longer moves.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_h.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_h.text: At school I'm 'School Nurse,' right? Another title. *With a slight smile* But you — you've never once called me by a title, have you?

hidden_nurse_d4_4_j.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_j.text: You just call me 'teacher' — not 'school nurse.' I liked that.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_k.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_k.text: *Paperwork is done. The school nurse taps the name field once with her finger, then finally stretches.*

hidden_nurse_d4_6_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6_c.text: *The school nurse glances toward {name} for a moment.* ...It is nothing.

hidden_nurse_d4_6_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_6_d.text: *'It's nothing' The corner of the folder presses against my fingertips behind me.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_b.text: You must've had this when you were a student too.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_c.text: When was that? *laughs* I'm not like I used to be anymore.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_b.text: *The she pauses. Sets down her chopsticks.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_b.text: *The hand holding the chopsticks stops on the table.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_c.text: *Smiling again* Alright, if you're done eating, you're dismissed. I've still got work to do.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_d.text: *On the way back. The School Nurse calls from behind.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_b.text: *The nurse presses down the cup noodle lid. One chopstick shifts slightly out of line.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.text: *My steps stop for a moment, and then I keep walking past.*

minsu_cheer_4_ins_single.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_ins_single.text: *I check my phone calendar. There's only one date today. — This time, I'm not putting anything off.*

morning4_yuna_msg_single.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_single.text: *Short. But today that brevity feels sharp. There aren't any other plans. — This time, I'm really going to that one place.*
